icons_and_assets.illustration_style: Soft, friendly, using SVG illustrations or bright stock photos.

hero_image.description: Young man using laptop and headphones for online learning, representing an engaged student.

accessibility.contrast_ratio: Ensure >4.5:1 for normal text. Avoid light text on light yellow backgrounds.
accessibility.focus_states: Visible focus rings on all interactive elements (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-sky-300).
accessibility.test_ids: Required on all buttons, inputs, links, and key UI areas (e.g., data-testid='chat-submit-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Load 'Outfit' and 'Nunito' fonts from Google Fonts in index.html.
Update /app/frontend/src/index.css to implement the provided colors (convert HEX to HSL variables if using shadcn).
Use 'Outfit' for headings (h1, h2, h3) and 'Nunito' for the body text globally.
Apply 'rounded-2xl' or 'rounded-3xl' universally to cards, inputs, and modals for a friendly EdTech feel.
Implement the Chat Interface using the defined 'ai_message' and 'user_message' styling, providing a clear visual contrast between the AI Tutor and User.
Use Recharts for the Progress Dashboard. Apply the Sky Blue (#0EA5E9) and Amber (#F59E0B) colors to charts.
For the dashboard layout, utilize the 'bento_grid' approach, emphasizing asymmetry and clean negative space.
Never use pure black or grey (#000000 or #808080). Always use tinted slates from Tailwind (slate-50 to slate-900).
Use the provided image URLs exclusively for hero sections, dashboard banners, and auth backgrounds. No placeholder images are allowed.
